fix(colour): the door's ✖ is red as each depth draws it, the theme's own wherever one reads (87n6) (#803)

* fix(colour): the door's ✖ is the theme's own red as each depth draws it (87n6)

* fix(colour): the door's ✖ takes the first red to clear the text floor, else the farthest (87n6)

* fix(colour): the door's ✖ ranks its reds in one comparison, and says where the terminal's red stands in (87n6)

* docs(colour): errorRedOn states its general contract (87n6)

fix: a link publish that stood is its outcome, and the session file's chain settles whatever a write did (ooi7)

A staged name that would not go after the link is now said beside the
outcome rather than thrown in its place, so endJob still signals the group
and a raced link key still reads the key that landed. The write chain
settles on a write's failure as well as its success, the write keeps its
own error with its code, the success log runs after the try, cleanup
failures are Errors (realm-safe), writeAtomic keeps only permission bits,
and the usage cache publishes whole.

fix: staging syncs nothing, applies a mode exactly, and one bad write no longer stops the session file (ooi7)

No publish syncs: the writes run on clicks and at start, often on the
daemon's thread, and the shutdown flush must finish inside its backstop. A
given mode is chmodded past the umask. The async form's cleanup stays off
the thread, and a link's cleanup error keeps its code and ignores a staged
name already gone. The session file encodes inside its write's try, keeps
at most one write waiting, and its flush rejects when its write fails.

fix: every staged file is published through one operation, under a name unique to its call (ooi7)

Two processes writing one file staged at one shared name, so one could
publish the other's half-written bytes and the other's rename then failed
ENOENT. Staging now names the file per call, syncs it before the publish,
and removes it on failure, saying in the write's own error when it cannot.
The session state file's writes join one chain, so its flush is async and
no write supersedes another.
fix(edit): chrome name builders take names as written and escape inside (5bfl)

fix(edit): edit chrome spells preset and placement with one injective, readable identifier (5bfl)

A placement or preset name is letters and digits as they are and every
other code point as Z and six hex digits, so names that differ only in
punctuation keep their own chrome and menu keys. The preset collision
guard protected only the lossy preset spelling and is deleted.

fix(edit): edit chrome is named by the placement it serves, not by walk position (5bfl)

One walk counter spelled every insert slot, removal, configure control and
draft variable, so an add, removal or move renamed every control after it,
and an open menu, page or list landed on a neighbour. Every name is now
spelled from the placement's id through an injective spelling that is a
fixed point of ident, and the counter is gone.
